decisions.Kwic: 儻肯於劫外承當，更何必而今相見？

Decision.AttributionNote: Elder Linquan's Appraisals and Comments on Chan Master Danxia Zichun's Verses on Old Cases, the Empty Hall Collection (林泉老人評唱丹霞淳禪師頌古虗堂集), case five. Linquan Conglun is the exact commentator marked by 師云 who asks whether, if one can undertake it beyond the eon, there is any need to meet now. Dongshan Liangjie belongs to the case heading and is discussed in the comment; he is not the speaker of this sentence.

decisions.Kwic: 其實此事轉轆轆、活鱍鱍，如盤走珠，了無滯跡，方為可也。

Decision.AttributionNote: Elder Linquan's Appraisals and Comments on Chan Master Danxia Zichun's Verses on Old Cases, the Empty Hall Collection (林泉老人評唱丹霞淳禪師頌古虗堂集), case seventeen. In the continuous commentary introduced by 師云, Linquan Conglun says that this matter turns freely and is alive and darting, like a pearl running on a tray without any stagnant trace. Dongshan Liangjie is the case subject invoked earlier in the comment, not the speaker of this sentence.
